sites.functional_impact_measured: Surface display confirmed by live-cell anti-FLAG labeling (non-permeabilized cells, 37 °C and 4 °C); regulated endocytosis preserved upon isoproterenol stimulation (TIRF microscopy, percent internalization quantified at 5 and 30 min); HA-tagged construct additionally validated by FACS surface quantification and cAMP signaling assays (PMC12214593, PMC12962099).
sites.rationale: ADRB2 (UniProt P07550, 413 aa) has no signal peptide; the N-terminus is directly extracellular (topology landmarks: EXTRACELLULAR 1–33, TM1 begins at residue 34). A prepend tag (insert_after_residue=0) sits entirely within the 33-residue extracellular N-terminal domain, ≥33 residues from the TM1 boundary — well above the ≥3-residue minimum. Python verification confirms residue 1 = M and residue 34 = V (matching the V34A variant reported in PMC12962099, confirming canonical numbering). Five ledger entries from four independent papers all report N-terminal epitope or SNAP tags on full-length, membrane-anchored β2AR with extracellular accessibility confirmed in non-permeabilized cells. The N-terminal domain of β2AR does not contain the catecholamine-binding pocket (which is in the TM bundle), so a prepended tag does not occlude the orthosteric site. No ledger entry supports any insertion in ECL1 (96–107), ECL2 (172–197), or ECL3 (296–306). The C-terminal Venus fusion noted in PMC12962099 is intracellular (residues 328–413) and is excluded. N-terminally FLAG-tagged full-length β2AR expressed in βarr1/2 double-knockout HEK293 cells; surface display confirmed by live-cell M1 anti-FLAG labeling (Alexa Fluor 647) in non-permeabilized cells at 37 °C and at 4 °C; receptor undergoes regulated endocytosis upon 10 µM isoproterenol stimulation, measured as percent internalization by TIRF microscopy. Corroborated by PMC12214593 (N-terminal HA tag, surface confirmed by FACS with AF647-anti-HA in non-permeabilized cells; cAMP assays performed), PMC9246501 (N-terminal SNAP-tag fused to β2AR, CHX-chase degradation assay in HEK293 cells), PMC10853676 (SNAP-tagged β2AR in pDONR201 entry vector), and PMC12962099 (HA-B2AR-Rluc8 with N-terminal HA tag in HEK293 cells, cAMP assays). literature_notes: All five qualifying ledger entries converge on the extracellular N-terminus (insert_after_residue=0). The C-terminal Venus/Rluc8 fusions in PMC12962099 are intracellular (topology: INTRACELLULAR 328–413) and do not qualify as extracellular tag sites. No ledger entry reports any insertion in ECL1 (96–107), ECL2 (172–197), or ECL3 (296–306), so no internal extracellular loop sites are proposed. The HA and SNAP entries (PMC12214593, PMC9246501, PMC10853676, PMC12962099) all corroborate the same N-terminal position and are noted in evidence_detail but the FLAG entry from PMC9681205 is used as the primary supporting_quote because it provides the most complete surface-and-function validation dataset.
